source.note: Verbatim. Region tags added by hand; nothing else changed.

situation: A real irreversible-action confirmation — push commits and close a card — put to the user behind a sixteen-word lead-in. What is being decided and what turns on it appear nowhere in the framing; the reader learns both from the option list.
why_this_ask: It is the failure mode in its purest real form: the options carry the whole decision. Both counts pass comfortably, which is the point — a bare list is not a length defect and no ceiling would ever catch it.
co_occurring: JARGON-WALL and BURIED-ASK also fire. Real asks are not single-mode; the manifest states the exact set rather than the convenient one.
